text:
morgan: quick heads-up  ran the quarterly recurring-pattern pull and noticed a cluster that keeps coming back: fallback cascades triggered by probe storms + heavy checkpoint IO. i'm sketching proposed cleanups here.

ash: can you paste the raw query? curious about filters.

morgan: sure, used a simple query to get started: ```sql
SELECT incident_id, root_cause, COUNT(*) AS occurrences
FROM incident_events
WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-04-01'
AND tags && ARRAY['fallback','checkpoint','probe']
GROUP BY incident_id, root_cause
ORDER BY occurrences DESC;
```

tara: results look familiar. i flagged three Dedicated incidents where checkpoint spikes coincided with tenant backups.

pete: i saw the probe storm one: health-checks with <10ms variance caused synchronized retries. all probes hit at almost the same time.

ops-bot: auto-note: incident 1827004444 had 34 fallback events in 12m; median probe_jitter=4ms; recommended jitter=30-150ms.

ash: two practical actions: (1) gate checkpoint IO via IO-priority + backoff (owner: ash) ETA 2026-04-18; (2) change probe policy to include jitter + staggered readiness windows (owner: tara) ETA 2026-04-09.

morgan: i can take a third item  add a "graceful-degrade" step that reduces max_concurrency for a tenant before model fallback occurs. owner: morgan + zhen. ETA 2026-05-02.

zhen: will pair on the API surface for soft-degrade and add metrics to measure impact. planning to add a new gauge "tenant.max_concurrency_post_degrade".

ash: also propose an infra alert: "pattern-fallback-cascade-v1" when fallback_count >= 5 in 10m AND fallback_sources > 1. ops team, can infra create?

ops-bot: alert draft created: PATTERN_FALLBACK_CASCADE_V1; reviewers: infra-oncall, pete.

pete: i'll review alert semantics. also recommend a small canary before global rollout to avoid noisy alerting.

morgan: action recap (reply with :thumbsup: on thread to accept):
- ash: checkpoint IO gating + stage test (ETA 2026-04-18)
- tara: probe jitter + staggered readiness canary (ETA 2026-04-09)
- morgan + zhen: soft-degrade API + metrics (ETA 2026-05-02)
- pete/ops: create cascade alert draft + canary plan (ETA 2026-04-05)

ash: +1 :thumbsup: starting a config PR for IO cgroups.

tara: +1 i'll open a small RFC and a k8s readiness job for the canary.

zhen: +1 will stub the metrics dashboard.

pete: +1 will schedule alert canary.

morgan: also found a secondary theme: remediation ownership drift. a handful of PMR rows show owner=null or owner=unresponsive. i'd like a lightweight sweep to reassign or escalate.

ash: we should add a tag 'sweep_exempt' for items intentionally blocked. sweep should skip those.

ops-bot: last sweep run: 2026-02-12. 21 items flagged; 14 resolved, 7 still unassigned.

morgan: proposed sweep policy: weekly job that lists actions where (owner is null OR last_update > 30 days) AND not tagged 'sweep_exempt'. automation posts a message in the incident channel and pings oncall. owner: morgan. ETA: 2026-04-06.

zhen: agree. plus add a small SLA: if not reassigned in 7 days escalate to manager.

pete: ops can add webhook to create a digest to managers when escalation occurs.

morgan: scheduling a 20m follow-up on 2026-04-10 11:00 PT to check canary & sweep status. ops-bot can add calendar invite?

ops-bot: calendar invite created: 2026-04-10 11:00 PT. follow-up reminder set.

ash: i'll post initial perf numbers after IO-cgroup canary.

tara: will monitor readiness flips during probe canary.

zhen: will instrument metrics and add a dashboard link to tracker.

pete: will run alert canary and report back.

morgan: thanks all  please update the tracker row when you open PRs/tickets. i'll compile a short note for the patterns digest.

ash: copying notes into tracker now.

ops-bot: thread archived to incident-patterns index.
